This assignment will guide you through a practice question from Chapter 4 using **Combined Class Song Data**. [Download the dataset](../../data/index.html){target="_blank"} and open it in Jamovi.


## Part 1: Describe the distribution of LENGTH

1. Write down summary statistics for the variable `LENGTH` (length of the song in seconds) that would measure the Location, Spread, and Skewness of the distribution.  


2. Generate a histogram of the variable `LENGTH` and describe the shape of the distribution.



## Part 2: Transformations

1. Suppose I create a new variable `LENGTH2` calculated as `LENGTH2 = LENGTH/60` (i.e., length of song in minutes).  Calculate the values of the statistics you wrote down in Part I after the transformation.


2. Suppose I create a new variable `LENGTH3` calculated as `LENGTH3 = LENGTH + 2`.  Calculate the values of the statistics you wrote down in Part I after the transformation.
